title: graph_node.v1
description: Motadata-aligned configuration-item vertex on map/. Tenant lives on snapshot/Dest path, not on the node. CI-only types — alert/incident/metric/trace/change/ticket are never vertices.

entity_id.description: Canonical CI id within the Dest tenant. Same string as ingest ci_id / sketch entity_id after bind.

type.description: Motadata-style lowercase CI type (service, host, …). Non-CI Motadata names are rejected at admit.

metadata.description: JSON object encoded as a string (tags, origin, aliases, …).

last_seen.description: ISO-8601 timestamp refreshed on every upsert.
